_note: Which path renders the state each reference board depicts. The board-to-state association is AUTHORED here, in one file, because no source in the repository covers it: only 5 of 21 archetypes have a demo directory with any pages, and only 5 of these 27 boards have a demo page of the same name (measured, see mwg-train-elx3). A path is listed ONLY where a script in this repository was observed navigating to it - the verify-*-demo.mjs scripts drive these demos in a browser and their goto() calls are the evidence, recorded in `source`. Everything else is null with a reason, because an unestablished path would be a fabricated one and a wrong path is worse than an honest gap: the comparator would report a state mismatch against the wrong page. A board may instead carry an optional `drive` block, which is how a state with no path is captured: the comparator renders startPath, acts on the page (fill/submit) and screenshots the result, so a refusal re-render becomes measurable rather than permanently exempt (mwg-train-mr6t).

_schema.path: root-relative path a served demo answers, or null
_schema.source: what establishes the path, or why none is established
_schema.kind: page = a distinct document reachable by a path; interaction = a state of a page, reached by acting on it, so NO path selects it (see mwg-train-bosi); absent = the archetype has no demo to serve
_schema.drive: OPTIONAL, and only for a state with NO path: how to reach it in a browser - { startPath, fill, submit, expectText }. startPath defaults to '/'; fill is selector -> value; submit is the form selector; expectText is REQUIRED, the text the state must contain after the drive, because without it a submission that silently succeeded cannot be told from the refusal the board depicts and would be compared against it (mwg-train-pv44). A drive that does not render expectText is reported UNMEASURED rather than compared (mwg-train-mr6t). A board with a drive must have path: null
